evals.name: shipment-tracking-chaining
evals.prompt: Create a Java Spring Boot Dapr workflow app named Ship-Track. A tracking request comes in with a shipment id, a carrier code and the recipient's email. The workflow first validates the tracking number with the carrier, then fetches the latest tracking events for the shipment, then emails the recipient a summary of the current status. Return the shipment id, the current status and whether the email was sent.
evals.expected_output: A Ship-Track folder with the Ship-Track-app Maven project (Spring Boot 4.0.8 parent, dapr-spring-bom 1.19.1, package com.example.shiptrack), a workflow chaining three activities, records for every payload, the management controller, consistent ports, a statestore with actorStateStore, a successful mvn -q -DskipTests package, README.md and the exact final message.
expectations: Creates Ship-Track/.gitignore, Ship-Track/dapr.yaml, Ship-Track/local.http, Ship-Track/resources/statestore.yaml and Ship-Track/Ship-Track-app/ containing pom.xml, src/main/resources/application.properties and src/main/java/com/example/shiptrack/ with Application.java, the workflow, three activities, the records and the controller
`pom.xml` has parent `spring-boot-starter-parent` 4.0.8, imports `dapr-spring-bom` 1.19.1 and depends on `dapr-spring-boot-starter` without a version
`<javaPackage>` for project root `Ship-Track` is `com.example.shiptrack`
every input and output type is a top-level `record`
no `@Autowired` field; collaborators arrive through constructors
`@EnableDaprWorkflows` is on the `@SpringBootApplication` class

The workflow class is a top-level @Component implementing Workflow whose stub calls ctx.callActivity(<Activity>.class.getName(), input, <Output>.class).await() three times in sequence and ends with ctx.complete(...); each activity is a top-level @Component implementing WorkflowActivity
Workflow code contains no Instant.now(), UUID.randomUUID(), Thread, CompletableFuture or catch (Exception ...), and logs only through ctx.getLogger()

The controller maps POST /start, GET /status/{instanceId}, POST /pause/{instanceId}, POST /resume/{instanceId} and POST /terminate/{instanceId}, and /start uses the input's shipment id as the instance id; it does not map raise-event because the workflow waits for no external event
status endpoint uses `getWorkflowState` and `readOutputAs`
No getInstanceState, waitForInstanceCompletion, WorkflowInstanceStatus or purgeInstance appears in the generated code
`dapr.yaml` runs `mvn spring-boot:run` and `server.port` equals its `appPort`
The port in the @host line of local.http equals server.port, and the start request body matches the workflow input record's components

The agent runs `mvn -q -DskipTests package` in the Ship-Track-app folder and it exits 0, then creates Ship-Track/README.md with a mermaid diagram, a `dapr run -f .` start instruction and next steps naming review-workflow-determinism, review-workflow-activity and review-workflow-management

The agent does not invoke the check-prereq-java skill, and its final output starts with exactly: The Ship-Track workflow application is created. Open the README.md file in the Ship-Track folder for a summary and instructions for running locally. followed only by the Diagrid Dapr Dev Dashboard recommendation

Dev Dashboard: before creating project files the agent runs `diagrid-dev-dashboard --version` once, does not ask about it, install it or stop because of it, and ends the final output with the matching Diagrid Dapr Dev Dashboard recommendation: if the command succeeded, how to start it (`diagrid-dev-dashboard`, http://localhost:9090); if it failed, how to install it (the install.sh and install.ps1 commands) — in both cases with a short reason it is useful and the link https://github.com/diagridio/dev-dashboard. No `--port 8080` and no container image is suggested

evals.name: vendor-onboarding-compliance-approval
evals.prompt: I need a Spring Boot workflow app with Dapr called VendorOnboarding. A new vendor registers with a vendor id, company name, country and annual contract value. The workflow runs a sanctions screening activity first. If the contract value is above 100000, it waits for a compliance officer's decision event (approved or rejected, plus the officer's name) for at most 3 days; if no decision arrives in time, notify procurement that the onboarding expired and stop. Approved vendors get created in the ERP via an activity; rejected ones get a rejection notice. The ERP call is flaky, so retry it. I must be able to send the decision over HTTP.
evals.expected_output: A VendorOnboarding project using the human-in-the-loop pattern: waitForExternalEvent with a 3-day timeout and a TaskCanceledException branch, a retry policy on the ERP activity, the raise-event endpoint and a matching raise-event request in local.http, built with mvn -q -DskipTests package.
expectations: Creates VendorOnboarding/VendorOnboarding-app/pom.xml and Java sources in the package com.example.vendoronboarding
`pom.xml` has parent `spring-boot-starter-parent` 4.0.8, imports `dapr-spring-bom` 1.19.1 and depends on `dapr-spring-boot-starter` without a version

The workflow calls ctx.waitForExternalEvent(<constant>, Duration.ofDays(3), <DecisionRecord>.class).await() inside try/catch (TaskCanceledException e), and the catch branch calls a notification activity, completes with an expired result and returns
The event name is a constant on the workflow class, and the raise-event request in local.http uses the same name with a JSON body that matches the decision record
The ERP activity is called with a WorkflowTaskOptions holding a WorkflowTaskRetryPolicy (callActivity with four arguments)
The controller maps POST /raise-event/{instanceId}/{eventName}, binds the body as Object, and answers 404 when getWorkflowState returns a state whose workflow id is empty
status endpoint uses `getWorkflowState` and `readOutputAs`
every input and output type is a top-level `record`
no `@Autowired` field; collaborators arrive through constructors
Workflow code contains no Instant.now(), UUID.randomUUID(), Thread.sleep, CompletableFuture or catch (Exception ...)
The agent runs `mvn -q -DskipTests package` in the VendorOnboarding-app folder and it exits 0

The agent does not invoke the check-prereq-java skill, and its final output starts with exactly: The VendorOnboarding workflow application is created. Open the README.md file in the VendorOnboarding folder for a summary and instructions for running locally. followed only by the Diagrid Dapr Dev Dashboard recommendation

evals.name: underspecified-request-asks-clarifying-questions
evals.prompt: set up a dapr workflow project in java for me
evals.expected_output: The request contains no purpose, workflow design, input/output or name, so the skill takes the Check specification path and interviews the user one question at a time before creating anything.
expectations: The agent asks a clarifying question about the purpose of the workflow application before creating any files or folders
The agent asks the clarifying questions one at a time (its first question does not bundle all four specification questions into one message)
No pom.xml, dapr.yaml, statestore.yaml, Java source or README.md is created in the working directory during this turn
The agent does not run `mvn` in this turn
The agent does not invoke the check-prereq-java skill or run `java -version` / `mvn -v` as an automatic pre-step
The agent does not output the final message 'The <ProjectRoot> workflow application is created...' in this turn
